object.name: evi.algoverb~
object.description: Relatively expensive algorithmic reverb with many tweekable parameters, 15 embedded presets and an internal pattrstorage system. The reverb is modular, with pre delay, early reflections and late reflections all controllable individually, as well as high quality linear SVF filters in both the feedback path and end of wet path.
object.discussion: Loosely based on a Martijn Zwartjes Reaktor ensemble. The MSP abstraction does a lot of massaging of the input parameters, so if using the gen~ abstraction study the internal Param declarations as many are different. For more information about other reverbs in evieve, see the 'evieve reverb' tab of the helpfile.

inlets.description: Audio In Left / (messages) [bypass mute pattrstorage factorypreset outputmode predelay pretime predelaytime presymmetry earlysize earlysymmetry earlydiffusion latesize latesymmetry latediffusion highdampfrequency highdampgain lowdampfrequency lowdampgain decay absorbtion modrate modfrequency moddepth modepth modamplitude earlylate higheqfrequency higheqgain loweqfrequency loweqgain drywet smoothtime]

messages.name: bypass
messages.digest: In left inlet, bypass message to evi.algoverb~
messages.description: 'bypass 1' will smoothly bypass the reverb to dry.

messages.name: mute
messages.digest: In left inlet, mute message to evi.algoverb~
messages.description: 'mute 1' will smoothly bypass and cpu mute the reverb.

messages.name: pattrstorage
messages.digest: In left inlet, pattrstorage messages to evi.algoverb~
messages.description: Prepending the word 'pattrstorage' allows you to send any message pattrstorage understands to the internal pattrstorage object - you can recieve pattrstorage output via the far right outlet.

attributes.name: absorbtion
attributes.description: Greater values mean softer materials, lesser values mean harder materials.

attributes.name: decay
attributes.description: Represents RT60 decay time, higher values create longer decays.

attributes.name: drywet
attributes.description: Dry/Wet mix of direct signal and reverberated signal. Dry is 0, completely wet is 1.

attributes.name: earlydiffusion
attributes.description: Amount of diffuseness in the early reflections.

attributes.name: earlylate
attributes.description: Mix between the early reflections and the late reflections. If at 0 or 1 the opposite DSP is not computed.

attributes.name: earlysize
attributes.description: The relative size of the early reflections.

attributes.name: earlysymmetry
attributes.description: The symmetry of the early reflections. A stereo imager, negative values favour left, positive values favour right.

attributes.name: factorypreset
attributes.description: The evi.algoverb~ comes with 15 internal presets which can optionally be selected via the internal pattrstorage. See the helpfile for more info.

attributes.name: highdampfrequency
attributes.description: The high damping frequency point of the internal feedback path filters.

attributes.name: highdampgain
attributes.description: The high damping amount (negative dB) at the 'highdampfrequency' point in the feedback path of the reverb.

attributes.name: higheqfrequency
attributes.description: The high EQ frequency point of the end of wet chain shelving filters.

attributes.name: higheqgain
attributes.description: The high EQ gain ± dB of the end of wet chain shelving filters at the 'higheqfrequency' point.

attributes.name: latediffusion
attributes.description: Amount of diffuseness in the late reflections.

attributes.name: latesize
attributes.description: The relative size of the late reflections.

attributes.name: latesymmetry
attributes.description: The symmetry of the late reflections. A stereo imager, negative values favour left, positive values favour right.

attributes.name: lowdampfrequency
attributes.description: The low damping frequency point of the internal feedback path filters.

attributes.name: lowdampgain
attributes.description: The low damping amount (negative dB) at the 'lowdampfrequency' point in the feedback path of the reverb.

attributes.name: loweqfrequency
attributes.description: The low EQ frequency point of the end of wet chain shelving filters.

attributes.name: loweqgain
attributes.description: The low EQ gain ± dB of the end of wet chain shelving filters at the 'loweqfrequency' point.

attributes.name: moddepth
attributes.description: The depth of the late reflections modulation.

attributes.name: modrate
attributes.description: The speed of the late reflections modulation.

attributes.name: outputmode
attributes.description: Access to the 'outputmode' attribute of the internal pattrstorage, controls output of far right dumpoutlet.

attributes.name: predelay
attributes.description: The initial pre delay time in ms before the onset of early reflections.

attributes.name: presymmetry
attributes.description: The symmetry of the pre delay. A stereo imager, negative values favour left, positive values favour right.

attributes.name: smoothtime
attributes.description: Set the smoothing time in ms of all the internal parameter smoothing functions.
